fallback_when_md5_absent.rule: Laravel resolves the dictionary row by lang + cleaned_word; a word not in the dictionary is rejected with rejection_code (inside a delivery batch: item status delivery.batch_item_statuses.no_target) and no row is created

http_transfer.response_profiles: Every request with a body declares its response profile (http_client response=): control = short request/reply (caller timeout or the client default, per-read idle); upload = body >= one chunk, stall-driven write (idle_timeout_seconds), unbounded response wait guarded by TCP keepalive; llm / tts / image = small body, long backend computation: read bound from response_wait_seconds (or the caller's bound). A bodied request without a profile is a call-site error.

clip_ready.payload: {ids: string[]} resource ids sha256("kind:language:content") of clips whose audio just landed (words: trimmed lower-case word, sentences: content id); the client matches them against the ids it waits for and fetches by id through audio/bundle; no text, no url; ids of one request are coalesced into events of at most max_ids
clip_ready.fallback: the client polls audio/lookup at transfer.generation_recheck_seconds only until the stream session has delivered a clip.ready (an older server never emits it) and while the stream is down

clip_leased.payload: {node: sid, ids: string[]} resource ids (same sha256 identity as clip.ready) of requested clips (priority at or above the want level: wordnew promotion or want entry) a node just leased, with that node's short id (work_nodes sid); no text; plain backlog rows are not announced; chunked at max_ids
clip_leased.clear: a client drops an id on clip.ready, when work_nodes shows the node offline or without leases, and after work_leases.lease_ttl_seconds without a new clip.leased for it

head_parts.description: Each audio lane (word_audio, sentence_audio) owns its OWN Queue = Part1 + Part2 (one whole-Queue heap per lane; the lanes never mix). Every mutation and dedup is whole-Queue. The split may be VISUALIZED read-only; actors never address a part. Binding doc: docs_fix/DESIGN_QUEUE_PIPELINE.md.

parts.part1: pycore-local priority. Filled ONLY by audio orchestration manifest misses (missing words -> word_audio Part1, missing sentences -> sentence_audio Part1; local tasks owned by the orchestration task) and the pycore-manager manual promote. NEVER notifies Laravel. Empty by default.
parts.part2: This node's Laravel work: the rows of its work leases (work_leases; disjoint per node) and claimed Laravel global tasks. wordnew promotion raises the row's lease priority on Laravel and wakes the lanes to claim.

head_parts.ordering: Every Part1 item sits in front of every Part2 item (part_rank 0 < 1), ahead of queue_position; language tier then queue_position then FIFO within a part.
head_parts.operation: ANY head promotion operates on the WHOLE Queue; dedup always runs against the whole Queue (an item exists at most once across parts; a Part1 copy keeps its front position).
head_parts.generation: One generator per item: an owner take_local()s its Part1 items before generating and settle_local()s the outcome; items a lane worker popped settle through complete(ok, provider).
head_parts.direction: Laravel -> pycore only. pycore never sends head state to Laravel.

audio_lane_state.description: State-driven Word Audio / Sentence Audio: pycore owns the lane truth (switch, lifecycle, section contract, Part1/Part2/whole-Queue view, Part1 tracker, worker, outbox, work leases) and pushes it on every change.
audio_lane_state.rpc: ui/queue_center/audio_lane_state {owner?, item_limit?} -> {instance, revision, lanes: {word_audio, sentence_audio}, wordAudio, sentenceAudio}
audio_lane_state.control_response: ui/task_center/set_queue_center_control returns lane_state (the same payload) for audio lanes
audio_lane_state.revision: monotonic per pycore instance; the UI ignores payloads older than the one it holds (reset on a new instance)
audio_lane_state.activation: one ON chain per lane: restore local Part1 items -> release the worker's stale leases -> claim a work lease batch -> drain
audio_lane_state.leases: lanes.<lane>.leases = {leases, items_leased, last_batch, done_per_hour, claim_in_seconds, pooled, lost, engines, languages}; lost = {reason_code: LEASE_LOST, leases, rows} once a renew reported a lease lost, else null

schema_gate.rule: Laravel compares the schema revision its code requires with the revision sys:init last recorded. While they differ, /api/health reports schema=pending, and every work-lease, report, delivery and gap-listing route answers http_status with error_code and retry_after_seconds before touching the gap tables; timers that need the new columns skip. A worker treats the code as a server-side pause: it claims nothing, keeps finished results in its outbox without counting a failure or an attempt, shows assist reason SERVER_SCHEMA_PENDING and retries after retry_after_seconds.

diff_delivery.cursor_store: Persistent revision and high-water metadata only.
diff_delivery.id_page_store: Bounded ID pages; queue-head moves update this layer without loading rows.
diff_delivery.data_segment_store: Full records are materialized only on a UI or consumer request and compacted after consumption.

nodes_event.rule: Emitted on lease claim, renew, release, reaper expiry, node online/offline and pool count changes; leading edge at most every min_interval_seconds, a change inside the window is coalesced into one trailing event. Carries only a revision: the UI refetches work_nodes when the revision moves and reconciles by one refetch after a reconnect; no polling timer.

work_leases.description: Multi-node work distribution for the gap lanes. Laravel is the single scheduler: a node claims a WORK LEASE (a disjoint batch of gap rows, atomic UPDATE ... WHERE id IN (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) on the row itself: tts_locked_by, tts_lease_id, tts_lease_expires_at), renews it while it works and delivers each item by content. No node mirrors the backlog: it holds its leased batch plus a prefetch. An expired lease returns its rows to the pool (claim treats expired rows as free). Binding: docs_fix/DESIGN_QUEUE_PIPELINE.md.

rank.word_audio: tts_priority DESC, query_count DESC, id ASC

work_leases.priority_source: tts_priority is raised by wordnew promotion (generate:laravel, queue head) and by a claim's want list; it replaces the retired {queue}_head tickets and global_tasks rows of these lanes.

routing.language: a row is leased only to a node that declared its language for the lane; a language no online node declares stays pooled with reason NO_CAPABLE_NODE (never failed)
routing.compute: lane class from task_types[].compute: gpu_preferred rows go to gpu nodes first; a cpu_only node gets them only while no online gpu node declares the lane+language; gpu_required never goes to a cpu_only node
routing.fair_share: per lane and language a claim takes at most free x own_weight / (own_weight + sum of the other eligible online nodes' weights) rows (at least 1; unbounded while no other eligible node serves it); weight = max(1, items/h); a gpu node on a cpu_ok lane weighs gpu_cpu_lane_weight x its rate while a gpu_preferred lane it serves still has free rows, so gpu nodes prefer sentences (qwen3tts), cpu and cpu-colab nodes carry words (kokoro) and no node starves
routing.online: a node is online while its last claim/renew/heartbeat is younger than lease_ttl_seconds

claim_request.node_id: optional stable device id (first 12 hex of the pycore relay device id); workers sharing it are one node
claim_request.platform: optional notebook platform (colab|kaggle); absent on a desktop or server node
claim_request.label: optional host label, at most 32 chars
claim_request.throughput_per_hour: {lane: items/h} the node can do: max(its completions rate, parallel slots / mean task seconds); Laravel sizes the batch from max(this, its own measured rate), so the batch is never capped by how little work the node was given

want.content_key: sentence content_id | word md5 (optional for a word that sends text)
want.text: word lane only: the cleaned word when the node has no md5 (Laravel computes the md5); never sent for sentences

claim_request.want_rule: want = the node's local generation list (its orchestration / manual queue head, ids only). Laravel raises the free gap rows to the want priority so the OTHER online nodes lease them first and excludes them from this node's own claims for exclude_ttl_seconds (at most exclude_max keys per lane+language, newest kept), so the node works the list locally and the rest work it from Laravel with no overlap; rows Laravel does not hold (ad-hoc playback text) stay local and reach Laravel through the content-keyed report, which creates them from text
claim_request.plan_id: optional book plan id (audio_orchestration_contract book_plan): a node working for an app's book plan names it; Laravel re-raises that plan's head window before leasing, so the plan's rows lead this claim
lease_ids: held leases, renewed in the same call

items.engine_hint: string|null: the engine this row must be synthesized with (audio_orchestration_contract book_plan.fast_pass: the fast engine for a fast-pass row, the quality engine for an upgrade)
items.variant_key: string|null: set on a quality upgrade (the base clip already exists); the node reports the audio as this variant

claim_response.retry_after_seconds: int, set when items is empty

progress.<lane>: progress_template of the lane's gap (total, done, failed, pending, cursor, updated_at, languages)

release_request.lease_id: optional; omitted = every lease of the worker (node start/stop)

work_leases.nodes_request: GET work/nodes; ?online=1 lists online nodes only and no pool

nodes_response.revision: int, the work_nodes.changed cursor: a client refetches only when it moved

nodes.sid: short stable node id (sid_length hex chars of sha1 of the node key: the claim node_id, i.e. the pycore device id, else the worker_id); every worker of one device shares it; the id clip.leased and assignment windows carry
nodes.workers: lane -> worker_id of the node worker serving that lane (assignments and leases still bind to the lane worker); worker_id is the node's first online worker
nodes.label: host label from the claim (colab/kaggle: <platform>-<first 6 of device id>)|''
nodes.lane_rates: lane -> items/h of that lane worker (done_per_hour is their sum)
nodes.compute_class: gpu|cpu (a pycore reporting cpu_only is published as cpu)

work_leases.delivery: Results go to the existing content-keyed reports from any origin (lease, orchestration, delivery batch): sentence -> audio_sentence_report by content_id, word -> audio_word_report by the row id (dict_row_id, encoded by the worker). A report clears the row lease and closes the gap row; a late or duplicate report answers 200 with already_done.
work_leases.resurface_rule: Failed resurfacing: per lane and language at most resurface_batch failed rows still in the gap (words also not is_valid false) return to pending with tts_attempts 0, at most once per resurface_interval_seconds, walking a persisted id cursor that wraps at the end of the table, so each row is retried at most once per sweep. One summary log line per finished sweep.

sentence_quality.rule: Quality floor: a sentence clip is accepted only when generated by an accepted engine (qwen3tts, GPU). Laravel rejects a sentence report whose provider is not accepted (422, row left in the pool, nothing stored), a sentence row is leased only to gpu nodes (task type sentence_audio is gpu_required) and a pycore never synthesizes or reports sentence audio with another engine. Words keep any engine (kokoro on CPU is fine). Stored sentence audio whose recorded provider is not accepted is not final: sys:init returns the row to the pool (has_audio false, file kept) and the next accepted report replaces the file.

sentence_language_focus.rule: Which sentence languages a node declares on a claim. Declared order is only a preference (Laravel splits a claim evenly over the open languages), so routing is by declaration. A notebook (colab|kaggle) node with a GPU declares only the notebook_gpu languages; any other node declares every language it can speak with the default languages first and drops a notebook_gpu language while an online gpu notebook node declares it for the lane (peer check = GET work_nodes?online=1, cached peer_refresh_seconds). A claim that returned no rows widens the next claim to every language, so no GPU idles while any language has a gap. A notebook node without a GPU declares no sentence language (kokoro is below the quality floor) and claims words only.

work_leases.repool_rule: A failure report whose error carries one of repool_error_codes is a node capability or scheduling miss (unsupported engine language, no capable node, lost lease, engine memory pause), not a content failure: the row returns to the pool (status pending, attempt not counted) and the node stays excluded by its declared languages.

delivery.description: W7 pycore -> Laravel resource delivery (server identity, Laravel-side diff, batch upload over offset-v1). Binding doc: docs_fix/DESIGN_QUEUE_PIPELINE.md.

progress_template.description: The one progress shape of every queue and lane (diff progress, gap listings, task-center summaries). total = done + failed + pending. Task queues: done = completed, failed = failed, pending = pending + assigned + processing. Gap lanes (word/sentence audio, word translation): done = has the artifact, pending = still missing it, failed = last attempt failed and not retried yet. cursor = the requesting consumer's keyset position (last row id served), null without a consumer. Optional languages map carries the same counts per language. No other keys.

lane_state.description: pycore lane state pushed on SSE topic queue_center.audio_lane.changed (lanes.<lane>) and returned by RPC ui/queue_center/audio_lane_state. progress = progress_template exactly as Laravel sent it for the lane's task type. assist = the node's compute state for the lane (device and engine null unless running; reason_code, one of assist_reason_codes, only when state is blocked: RESULT_CIRCUIT_OPEN = result posts kept failing with 5xx so intake paused, LANE_HALTED = lane stopped immediately, ENGINE_MEMORY_PAUSED = the lane engine waits for host memory). leases = the audio lane's work-lease state (audio lanes only, see audio_lane_state.leases). skipped = the last intake cycle's released and skipped rows aggregated by reason code.

metric_semantics.pending: Ready work that has not been claimed.
metric_semantics.leased: Claimed or assigned work that has not started processing.
metric_semantics.total: All records represented by the section; live queue sections sum pending, leased, and processing only.
